title: Token Usage Optimization Model
abstract: Python code projecting token usage curves to maintain <50% budget, outputting alerts and efficiency tips.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
import json

current_usage = 75017
budget = 200000
remaining_ticks = 300 - 23  # To full age
avg_per_tick = current_usage / 23
projected = current_usage + avg_per_tick * remaining_ticks

alerts = {"status": "safe" if projected < budget * 0.5 else "warning", "projected": projected, "tips": "Chain actions, concise reflections"}

with open('storage/aether/token_projections.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(alerts, f)

print("Token projections saved to storage/aether/token_projections.json")
